settlements.name: Venetian Las Vegas - Data Privacy (California)
settlements.description: You may be included in this settlement if you are a California resident and accessed the Venetian Las Vegas website between September 18, 2024 and March 16, 2026.

settlements.name: Amazon - Return Policy
settlements.description: You may be included in this settlement if you initiated a return to Amazon or requested a refund regarding a physical product purchased between September 5, 2017 and August 13, 2026.

settlements.name: Laboratory Services Cooperative - Data Breach
settlements.description: You may be included in this settlement if your personal information was exposed in the Laboratory Services Cooperative data breach discovered in October 2024.
